overview: The Ritual Academy is the center of Akhevan arcane education, where initiates learn void‑arcane resonance and ceremonial doctrine.
history: Founded to formalize Akhevan ritual instruction.
Resonance classrooms added to stabilize void‑arcane training.
Practice chambers expanded to support advanced ceremonial alignment.
Praesertum decrees integrated civic doctrine into Academy curriculum.
Modern Academy remains the highest institution of arcane learning in Ka Vethan.
hooks: A practice chamber destabilizes during training.
An instructor requests help with a corrupted ritual echo.
Initiates report anomalous void signatures in a lecture hall.
A Praesertum directive mandates new ritual curriculum changes.
